M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).

sources.components: the foci formula, as the Temple 40+'s (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt II (spell 81): 1 Iron Scarab and 2 Prismatic Taper; Flame Bolt III (spell 82): 1 Copper Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: II (spell level 2): Iron Scarab, Grey Taper, Hawthorn, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; III (spell level 3): Copper Scarab, Red Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above.
sources.supplies: M6 14 (m6-life-through): Harm Other I to IV add Mandrake 775 and Hemlock Talisman 747 on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts, the dats), Values 10 and 5 (weenie_properties_int type 19), sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304 (weenie_properties_create_list rows 20989 and 21023, destination 4) at ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1) = 14 and 7, one each, no trip line and no stop line, as M6 7 AN's: a missing one drops the level by name (LevelFloor); read on the read-only world copy 2026-11-12. M6 7 AN: the regeneration lines, the drains and Heal Self add Alder Talisman 627 and Damiana 768 on the account test's formula, sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304 at ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1), one each, no stop line (RechargeComponentTests pins every component of these lines). M6 7 AK: the self buffs and the item armor lines I to IV on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts, the dats): every component of them one each, all sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304, price ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1), no stop line and no trip line: a missing one drops the level by name (LevelFloor). M6 7 AD: the dance's lines (Stamina to Mana Self I on the account test's formula: Lead Scarab, Saffron, Powdered Amber, Quicksilver, Willow Talisman; the Lead Scarab line trips and stops under 1 (she comes with the outskirts' keep of 10 and a press burns one in a thousand) because Drain Health Other I burns one and GearKit.CastBurns reads every stock line of a cast; ComponentLoss 0.01 x CDM 1 for a herb or powder, 0.1 for a scarab or talisman): trip_under 0 and stop_under 0 as M6 7 X's lines: they call no trip and stop no run, a press short of one leaves the rest to the regeneration, named. 140 presses an hour burn 1.4 of each herb and powder, so keep 4 is nearly three hours between trips. M6 3 p1, sized from the rung 'lodge' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 150 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 5.2 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 780 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt III as the worst case, 3 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 2340 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 400 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 130 (a third of the keep), stop_under 4 (a cast needs 3). Scarabs (Cindrue: Iron 689 at 68, Copper 686 at 135, Silver 688 at 338, the draft's town half, Value x 1.35): the cap level's keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2; a lower level's keep 10, trip_under 3; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 5.1 hours at 780 casts an hour. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 16,530 pyreals at the vendors' prices; purse: coin 17,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (the Pathwarden robe and the Training Wand serve; a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 7 V (the r1h climb: at level 10 with 14 coin the counters called the Mana Potion trip over and over, and one trip spent 9,907 on 198 items): trip_spend_percent 60: one trip's stock buys spend at most 60 percent of the purse (coin and note faces), so the coin for the next trip stays (ResupplyPlanner.BuyList buys the lines under their trip lines first, the components before the potion, then tops up to the keeps in the same order); a trip line whose price the purse cannot pay is held back (LogisticsCounters, logged once a line), so the fight goes on. Rung scale: Copper Scarab keep 10, trip_under 5 (a trip's travel casts about 4, so 10 is 2 trips and a margin; 20 cost 2,700); Mana Potion keep 2, trip_under 1, stop_under 0 (230 each: one a trip as the reserve). Iron Scarab 10 stays (0.005 x 780 casts an hour = 3.9 an hour: 2.6 hours). M6 7 X (spells are the armor): the stock lines of Armor Self, Bludgeoning Protection Self and Mana Renewal Self II and III on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts: no focus of Life Magic is held; SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount over the dats, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_low_grounds_carry_the_protective_lines_formula): keep 2 (two casts: the formula burns a component only at ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 a cast, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d, and a buff is cast twice an hour), trip_under 0 (a trip that happens buys them and none is called for them: r2b's trip the moment she arrived, as the Mana Potion line), stop_under 0 (a buff short of a component steps down a level, BuffCycle.Choose; it never ends the run). Each is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, destination 4: Violet 21042, Green 21038, Brown 21043, Blue 21040, Turquoise 21039, Orange 21036, White 21044, Wormwood 20994, Mugwort 20990, Cobalt 21011, Vitriol 21019, Gypsum 21013, Powdered Amber 20997, Cedar Talisman 21031, Willow Talisman 21030; Value 25 a taper, 10 a herb, 5 the rest; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7). M6 7 AR (the audit's row 19 and the Lodge's gap 7): Copper Scarab keep 5, trip_under 1, stop_under 1 and Silver Scarab keep 3, trip_under 1, as the Burrow: her purse at the door is about 1,400, a keep of 10 trips her for 1,215 on arrival. M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health drinks): Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, burden 15; 230 pyreals by the price rule): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first. Sized from the live hits of 2026-11-11 in the Tusker Cave (886 hits, mean 3.79, the largest plain hit 9, criticals of 13 and 18; 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack on her at health 114): a drink from the magic stance takes 2.5 s, so one Potion of Healing is 10 health a second, about what such a pack deals, and the 20 to 30 s a way out takes are 8 to 12 drinks; keep 30 is two to three of those and trip_under 6 is half of one (a trip the purse cannot pay is held back, LogisticsCounters.IsHeldBack). The fight drinks one only when the mana pays no heal or the next hit kills (HealthDrinks.Emergency), so the stock is a reserve and not a ration. Thelnoth sells no Health Tincture 27319 (50 health, 20 health a second): the nearest seller by the travel file is Ludora the Healer 2229 in Dryreach, a trip not built (TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip)); the Health Draught 2457 he also sells restores 10, 4 health a second, under what three tuskers deal, and is not stocked. M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): the Mana Potion keeps 100 (it was 200): the Mana Tincture of the town stock (30, bought at the stop in Dryreach) is the main mana drink while held, and the potions are the fallback for a short purse, a failed stop and the top-ups of 25 to 49 missing; 100 of them are 2,500 mana, one stretch between trips at the Cave's 4,000 an hour, and the four drinks together weigh 4,050. The Health Tincture's stop is built (the town_stock section; TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip) closed).

town_stock.name: Health Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health tinctures): Ludora the Healer 2229 of Dryreach, landblock_instance guid 0x7DA75026 at (177.166, 78.3451, 18.005) in landblock 0xDA75, outdoors (the row stores cell 0; the cell is the point's, x/24*8 + y/24 + 1 = 0x3C); her create list (destination 4) holds the Health Tincture 27319 (BoostValue 50 on Health, Value 500, burden 50) and her SellPrice is 1.55: 775 pyreals (max(1, ceil(1.55 x 500 - 0.1))); SELECTs on the world copy. Thelnoth of Holtburg does not sell it. The stop is made on the way out, from the Town Network (network-to-dryreach drops 48.8 m from her, dryreach-to-network stands 59.9 m from her: travel-routes.json). keep 12, trip_under 6: with a pack on her (8 to 11.6 health a second, 2026-11-11) a tincture a drink of 2.5 s is 20 health a second, the one drink that out-heals it; a stand of 20 to 30 s takes about 6, so the keep is two stands and the trip line one. The walk from the drop to her is not walked live yet (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): Ludora's create list (destination 4) holds the Mana Tincture 27322 (BoostValue 50 on Mana, Value 500, burden 50): 775 pyreals at her SellPrice 1.55; a SELECT on the world copy. It is the main mana drink while held (ManaDrinks: the biggest drink that fits whole in the missing mana). keep 30, trip_under 10: the Tusker Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11 between trips about 35 minutes apart, 2,333 mana a stretch; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, so the two cover a stretch and two thirds of the next, and the potions alone still cover one when the stop fails or the purse holds it back. The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks.

M6 7 lead (2026-11-06, live): a sale trip from a dungeon costs about 14 minutes, so sale_trip_value is 100,000 here, not 15,000: the trio at the Lodge paid about 19,000, and a trip a fight left 3 kills in 14 minutes. fight.source: M6 7 lead (the rehearsal r3, level 10): a retreat from this ground below Lifestone Recall is a walk of about 190 m through tuskers to the exit and then the island; a body at 17 of 48 with the tusker at half health dies on that walk with its mana spent. It stands and fights: Heal Self I out-heals one tusker's hits under Armor and Bludgeon Protection II, and the fight's emergency keeps the heal; the upkeep health stop is off (0 = never). M6 7 AB: the rest before the next pull, as the Burrow: pull_mana_percent 50: at level 15 about 3 casts of Flame Bolt II or III at 10 to 15 mana plus 2 heals over a bigger pool (a planning value: the Lodge is not yet measured); pull_aggro_metres 24: VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of Male Tusker 11. M6 7 AN (the owner, 2026-11-06): only enter the dungeon and only pull the next pack with full stamina and mana: pull_full_percent 100 is that bar, read before the entry portal and before every pull, each with a named check; she lies down to recharge (ACE GetStanceMod x3 lying, x2.5 sitting, mana x1): pull_rest_posture lie.

hunt.source: M6 7 AY (the owner's decision of 2026-11-06; AR's keep-out data, Mage/BigPackRule.cs): big packs stay allowed here, so keep_out is empty; two deaths to a big pack drop her back to the first three slots, the entry trio in 0x57490106, 0x5749010A and 0x5749010F (cache/m6/7/lodge-entry-survey.md section 1: slots 1, 2, 3 of the 57), until her mana grows: drop_back_keep_out is the cell of every other slot, respawn.slots here. The walk may cross them; an attacker from there is still fought (M5 D88).
